title: SAP EWM Analyst
description:
Your Job Koch Global Services India is seeking an SAP EWM Analyst to join its global Warehouse Management team. This role will design, configure, implement, and support SAP Extended Warehouse Management solutions that improve warehouse and supply chain operations. You will partner with business stakeholders and global technology teams to understand operational needs, translate requirements into scalable solutions, and support the continued development of SAP S/4HANA capabilities. Our Team You will be part of the Georgia-Pacific technology team within Koch Global Services India. The team works with global functional and technical professionals to design, develop, and deliver technology solutions that support Koch businesses. This role offers opportunities to contribute to global initiatives and help build technology capabilities in India. What You Will Do • Design and configure SAP EWM solutions that support warehouse and supply chain operations. • Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into functional and technical solutions. • Support SAP EWM initiatives associated with the Consumer Products Group Digital Core program. • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause and impact analyses, and recommend sustainable solutions. • Create and maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, test plans, training materials, and supporting documentation. • Develop and execute unit and integration testing and coordinate user acceptance testing with business stakeholders. • Collaborate with business subject matter experts and functional and technical teams to implement and support SAP solutions. • Provide SAP EWM subject-matter expertise and recommend solution alternatives based on business needs. • Support knowledge-sharing and training activities for users and team members. 
 • Participate in on-call rotation to support business-critical applications. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) • Experience configuring and supporting SAP Extended Warehouse Management solutions. • Experience implementing SAP EWM in an SAP S/4HANA environment. • Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into SAP functional designs and system configurations. • Knowledge of SAP EWM integration with SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA logistics, manufacturing, and supply chain processes. • Experience developing functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios, and user documentation. • Experience troubleshooting SAP production issues and completing root-cause and impact analyses. • Experience working with business stakeholders and distributed functional and technical teams. What Will Put You Ahead • Experience integrating SAP EWM with SAP MM, SD, PP, QM, or TM. • Experience with SAP Logistics, shipments, deliveries, and warehouse execution processes. • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA transformation or Digital Core programs. • Knowledge of SAP ABAP debugging and troubleshooting. • Experience supporti
